messages:
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): hey team, running into a weird issue — our hosted embeddings endpoint returns 1536-d vectors but our Dedicated cluster returns 1408-d. we just migrated some traffic and search quality tanked :/
Maya (Support): thanks for the report, @Eli. can you paste the curl you used and the model names for both calls?
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): sure. hosted call (works):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXXX' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-3-large", "input":["central park map" ]}'
```
Hosted response header snippet: `x-redwood-model: text-embed-3-large@v1.2.0`
Hosted response example: `{ "data": [{"embedding": [0.0012, 0.0023, ..., 0.045] }] }` (length 1536)
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): Dedicated call (broken):
```
curl -X POST https://dedicated-acmemaps.us.redwood/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-dedicated-YYY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-3-large", "input":["central park map" ]}'
```
Dedicated response header: `x-redwood-model: text-embed-3-large@v1.1.0-quant`
Dedicated response example: `{ "data": [{"embedding": [0.0034, 0.0019, ..., 0.038] }] }` (length 1408)
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): obvious mismatch in dimensions. we pinned model name identical in our config. billing also showed doubled embedding units yesterday — we suspect retries.
Maya (Support): ugh. okay. first-pass checklist: 1) verify model variant/version on Dedicated, 2) check any auto-quantization/variant mapping in the Dedicated profile, 3) inspect request headers for `x-redwood-request-id` to correlate retries for billing. i'm looping in eng-runtime and eng-ml. @Ravi @Priya can you look?
Ravi (eng-runtime): looking. the headers you pasted show two different model variants — v1.2.0 (hosted) vs v1.1.0-quant (dedicated). quantized variants sometimes change the embedding vector layout if a sharded/optimized kernel drops padding dims. not typical — need concrete logs. @Eli can you share `x-redwood-request-id` from both responses?
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): hosted: `req_h_01C2...A1`, dedicated: `req_d_09F8...B2`. also here's the full response bodies (trimmed) and the raw Content-Lengths: hosted content-length 12288, dedicated 11264.
Priya (eng-ml): from an ML perspective, dimension changes usually mean the model variant is not semantically identical. possibilities: a different model family (tiny vs large), or a custom quantized build that prunes optimizer dims for speed. can you confirm the Dedicated deployment's model_artifact tag?
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): our Dedicated console shows `model_artifact: text-embed-3-large:2024-11-18:dedicated-build`
Ravi (eng-runtime): ok. internal check: Dedicated autosync may have fallen back to a compatible-but-not-exact artifact if the exact hosted artifact wasn't present in the dedicated repo. fallback mapping logs: `fallback_policy: match_by_family -> choose_compatible_quant` at 2025-11-09T04:12Z for cluster acmemaps-dedicated-1. that explains variant, but we still shouldn't change dimension. sounds like we shipped a mis-tagged artifact.
Maya (Support): can you reproduce locally with the dedicated endpoint? steps we should run for repro and debugging?
Priya (eng-ml): repro steps for us: 1) call both endpoints with same input batch and log `x-redwood-model`, `embedding.shape`, and checksum (sha256) of embeddings. 2) call with `batch_size=1` and `batch_size=32` to rule out batching padding issues. 3) fetch model manifest from the dedicated node: `/internal/models/{artifact}/manifest.json` and inspect `embedding_dimension`.
Maya (Support): @Eli can you run those and paste outputs? we'll also check billing logs for duplicate requests.
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): ran quick tests, summary: hosted (batch 1) dim=1536 checksum=sha256:abc123; dedicated (batch 1) dim=1408 checksum=sha256:def456. batch32 hosted dim=1536; batch32 dedicated dim=1408. so batching not the cause.
Ravi (eng-runtime): thanks. that rules out runtime padding. it's almost certainly an artifact mismatch. Priya, can we check dedicated artifact manifests for a known bad build?
Priya (eng-ml): checking internal model registry... found `text-embed-3-large@v1.1.0-quant` with manifest embedding_dimension: 1408. there's an open PR from a partner quantization that reduced dims for specialized hardware — it should NOT have been published to Dedicated clusters without explicit opt-in.
Ravi (eng-runtime): confirmed. deploy bot shows `deploy: text-embed-3-large@v1.1.0-quant -> acmemaps-dedicated-1` at 2025-11-09T04:20Z triggered by autosync. DeployBot: `deployment_id: dep_77a9b`
Maya (Support): ok we have root cause: autosync fallback picked a quantized artifact with different embedding dims. next steps to resolve?
Ravi (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation: revert dedicated cluster to the canonical hosted artifact `text-embed-3-large@v1.2.0`. I can trigger rollback to `v1.2.0` on acmemaps cluster. expected downtime: <90s per node rolling restart.
Priya (eng-ml): also adding a cluster-level guard: reject artifacts whose `embedding_dimension` doesn't match family default. will push a hotfix to the model registry and autosync policy.
Maya (Support): billing note — @BillingBot can you check the doubled billing for the day and if retries are recorded?
BillingBot: looked up invoices for acmemaps - 2025-11-09. Found 2 bursts of embeddings at 11:04 and 11:20 with identical request IDs (client retried due to 503). Possibility: client got a 503 and retried twice. refund policy: we can issue a usage credit for obvious duplicates after support review. please create a billing ticket if you want credit.
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): we did see some 503s during the window. yes please file the billing ticket, that'd help. also thanks for the quick triage. any permanent guard so this doesn't slip again?
Priya (eng-ml): permanence: 1) autosync policy change -> require exact `artifact_id` match for embeddings family (hotfix P0), 2) manifest validation on publish to prevent quantized artifacts without metadata `reduced_dims=true` from going to general pool, 3) alert when cluster model dims != catalog dims.
Ravi (eng-runtime): deploying rollback now. track: dep_77a9b -> rollback -> dep_77a9b.r1. I'll post logs when done.
DeployBot: rollback started for dep_77a9b at 2025-11-09T05:02:14Z.
Ravi (eng-runtime): rollback completed on node-1, node-2 rolling now.
DeployBot: rollback completed for dep_77a9b.r1 at 2025-11-09T05:03:57Z.
Ravi (eng-runtime): verified acmemaps-dedicated-1 now serves `text-embed-3-large@v1.2.0` and dims are 1536.
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): confirmed from our side — dims back to 1536 and search quality restored. thanks everyone.
Maya (Support): filing postmortem and follow-ups: 1) billing ticket for duplicate embeddings (Eli confirm), 2) autosync policy hotfix assigned to eng-runtime, 3) manifest validation assigned to eng-ml, 4) inform customers via status if impact > customers threshold.
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): please do the billing ticket, would appreciate a credit. also can you share a short repro snippet so we can add a detection on our side?
Maya (Support): repro snippet to detect dim mismatch:
```bash
# check dims for hosted vs dedicated
HOSTED_DIM=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXXX" -d '{"model":"text-embed-3-large","input":["x"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings | jq '.data[0].embedding | length')
DEDICATED_DIM=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-dedicated-YYY" -d '{"model":"text-embed-3-large","input":["x"]}' https://dedicated-acmemaps.us.redwood/v1/embeddings | jq '.data[0].embedding | length')
if [ "$HOSTED_DIM" -ne "$DEDICATED_DIM" ]; then echo "DIM_MISMATCH $HOSTED_DIM vs $DEDICATED_DIM"; fi
```
Maya (Support): adding final notes: if anyone sees similar reports from other customers ping `#incidents` and we'll triage. closing thread after billing ticket created. :white_check_mark:
SRE Oncall: add alert rule suggestion: `sum by(cluster,model) (count_over_time(embedding_requests[5m])) > 0 and min_over_time(embedding_dimension[5m]) != max_over_time(embedding_dimension[5m])` -> Pager.
Eli (Customer - AcmeMaps): thanks all. appreciated the fast turnaround! :pray:
